Choosing the right coverage

The right photographer or videographer does more than turn up on the day. They plan the run sheet with you, read the room, and deliver images and film you will keep for years.

Shortlisting two or three providers who cover Brisbane lets you compare style, coverage hours and inclusions before you commit.

Planning tip. Golden-hour light early in the evening makes for the best candids, so leave a little photo time before sunset.

Good to know

Common questions in Brisbane

How much does a wedding photographer cost in Brisbane?
What a wedding photographer costs in Brisbane depends on coverage hours, the number of shooters, editing and inclusions like albums or prints. Requesting quotes from photographers who cover Brisbane is the best way to see real local pricing for your day.
How far in advance should I book?
For weddings and peak-season events, popular photographers and videographers are often booked six to twelve months ahead. For smaller events a few weeks can be enough. The earlier you enquire, the more choice you have.
How many hours of coverage do I need?
Most full weddings are covered across six to ten hours, from getting ready to the reception. Shorter events and corporate functions may only need two to four hours. Tell us your run sheet and we will help match coverage to it.
Do photographers who cover Brisbane travel to my venue?
Most providers list a service area and many travel beyond it for a small fee. When you enquire, mention your Brisbane venue so they can confirm coverage and any travel costs.
